title: v5.8 gate on LAKE: all three layers managed at once for a full year with everything v5.6-v5.8 ships turned on — seasonal rotation, resident groups, migratory coupling with packs of five, leader cohesion, the ecology switch, and the water job stocking to twelve every 5,000 ticks behind the wet-edge detector. 404,000 ticks, two replicates. Every 5,000 ticks the wild units are counted per layer with the citizen count, the water status and the groups status. Pass: the water layer never empties and sits near its target, the surface and cavern layers keep arriving, no out-of-season arrival, the fort survives, and the save is byte-identical.
fork: Does v5.8 hold a three-layer map for a year with every earlier feature live, or do the layers fight each other.

predictions.expects: water near twelve all year, surface and cavern arrivals continuing, citizens alive, no out-of-season arrival, save byte-identical
water stocking starves the surface gate, or the ecology switch kills the placed fish, or the fort dies

kill_criterion: a year on all three layers with the water layer held, the other two still arriving and the fort alive, in 2 of 2, ships v5.8
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: all_layers
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.layers.land=true; cfg.layers.water=true; cfg.layers.cavern=true; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true end end; local a,f=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=true; cfg.groups.pack=5; cfg.groups.cohesion=true; cfg.ecology.enabled=true; cfg.water.enabled=true; cfg.water.target=12; cfg.water.cadence=5000; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('roster: all three layers — %d assigned, %d thin, %d applied; groups on, coupling on, cohesion on, ecology on, water stocking on (target 12/5000t); rotation enabled'):format(a,f,act))

local by={}; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isWildlife(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and not u.flags1.inactive then local r=u.animal.population; local L=(r.cave_id>=0) and 'cavern' or ((r.feature_idx>=0) and 'water' or 'surface'); by[L]=(by[L] or 0)+1 end end; local cz=0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isCitizen(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) then cz=cz+1 end end; local ok,w=pcall(dfhack.run_command_silent,'seasonal-wildlife','water'); local ok2,g=pcall(dfhack.run_command_silent,'seasonal-wildlife','groups'); print(('t6 layers: surface=%d water=%d cavern=%d citizens=%d season=%d day=%d | %s | %s'):format(by.surface or 0, by.water or 0, by.cavern or 0, cz, df.global.cur_season, math.floor(df.global.cur_year_tick/1200), ((w or ''):gsub('\n',' ')):sub(1,200), ((g or ''):gsub('\n',' | ')):sub(1,260)))
